title: Recording: All By Myself by Ringo Starr | 1974
content:
Sunset Sound Recorders, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

Ringo Starr recorded ‘All By Myself’ for his fourth studio album, Goodnight Vienna, on 8 August 1974.

It was one of two songwriting collaborations on the album by Starr and Vini Poncia, the other being ‘Oo-Wee’.

‘All By Myself’ was completed with additional overdubs on 17 September.

The only pop-in was on ‘All By Myself’. Alvin Robinson is an old New Orleans guitar player and a friend of Dr John’s. He stopped in and I had him play on that.
Richard Perry
Circus, March 1975
